title: 第20章  一脚就死了？这个废物也不算
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
“放肆！”

    正殿内响起一道略带薄怒的声音。

    那张娇媚的脸上，桃花眼如同结了冰的深潭，彻底失去温度。

    “这苍云岭的事，不是你一个镇魔卫能管的。”

    “三息之内离开这座庙，否则后果自负。”

    陆渊笑了。

    他发现人无语的时候是真的会笑。

    难道这长生教是大乾王朝的玄门正宗不成？

    明明是邪门歪道，竟然一个二个都不把镇魔卫放在眼里。

    他是真的想问一句，这苍云岭的事，不是镇魔卫来管还能有谁？

    陆渊眼神一凝，迈步走向正殿中央。

    道姑脸色微变，没想到一个年纪轻轻的镇魔卫竟敢与她硬刚。

    她嘴角勾起笑意，但眼神更冷了。

    抬手在空中虚虚一划，肉眼可见的阴气从她指尖溢出，凝成一道紫黑色符箓悬浮于虚空，黑光幽幽。

    一时间，殿内卷起凛冽阴风，气温骤降。

    “我说了......”

    紫黑色符箓伴有鬼哭狼嚎之声，向着陆渊面门直射过去。

    道姑眼神冷若冰霜，“三息，否则后果自负。”

    符箓爆发森寒阴风，直冲面门。

    陆渊神情淡然，锋棱晶刺从手中射出。

    一道晶芒在大殿闪过，紫黑色符箓在晶刺面前像是纸片一样脆弱，瞬间被刺成齑粉，浓烈的阴力四散飘飞。

    道姑瞳孔骤缩，一脸骇然，只见先前还在正殿门口的陆渊已经不见了身影。

    忽然耳边风声响起，道姑下意识抬手格挡，下一秒，势大力沉的一脚直接在她娇媚的侧脸炸开。

    嘭！

    劲风呼啸！

    那张极具媚态的俏脸瞬间扭曲，丰腴身段直接砸进墙壁之中。

    砖石碎裂，血水四溅。

    墙壁上的道姑半边脸颊血肉模糊，浑身上下像是散了架一样传来疼痛。

    她脑子里嗡嗡作响，口中满是血腥味，刚想说话，一口血沫混着几颗碎牙就吐了出来。

    怎么可能？

    她的阴煞符箓明明已经打出，却在那晶刺之下直接破碎。

    那可是她以尸魔阴气凝练而成的，别说是初境，就算是玄境武者都不一定能挡住。

    可对方——

    她还没想完，一只大手突然扣住她的脑袋，将她从墙上扯了下来，然后重重砸在地上。
content_en:
"Presumptuous!"

    A slightly angry voice sounded in the main hall.

    The peach blossom eyes on that charming face were like a deep pool of ice, completely losing their warmth.

    "This matter in Cangyun Ridge is not something that you, a demon-suppressing guard, can take care of."

    "Leave this temple within three breaths, otherwise you will bear the consequences."

    Lu Yuan smiled.

    He found that people really laugh when they are speechless.

    Could it be that this Immortality Religion is the authentic Taoist sect of the Daqian Dynasty?

    They are obviously evil, but they don't even take the Demon Suppressing Guards seriously.

    He really wanted to ask, if not the Demon Suppressing Guards, who else could take care of this matter in Cangyun Ridge?

    Lu Yuan's eyes narrowed and he walked toward the center of the main hall.

    The Taoist nun's face changed slightly. She didn't expect that a young demon-suppressing guard would dare to confront her.

    A smile appeared on her lips, but her eyes became colder.

    She raised her hand and made a vague stroke in the air. The yin energy visible to the naked eye overflowed from her fingertips and condensed into a purple-black talisman suspended in the air with a faint black light.

    Suddenly, a biting wind blew up in the hall, and the temperature dropped sharply.

    "I said..."

    The purple-black talisman, accompanied by the sound of ghosts crying and wolves howling, shot straight towards Lu Yuan's door.

    The Taoist nun's eyes were as cold as ice, "Three breaths, otherwise you will bear the consequences."

    A cold wind broke out from the talisman and rushed straight to the door.

    Lu Yuan's expression was indifferent, and sharp crystal thorns shot out from his hands.

    A flash of crystal light flashed across the hall, and the purple-black talisman was as fragile as a piece of paper in front of the crystal thorn. It was instantly turned into powder, and the strong Yin energy flew everywhere.

    The Taoist nun's pupils shrank suddenly, with a look of shock on her face. She saw that Lu Yuan, who was still at the door of the main hall before, had disappeared.

    Suddenly there was a sound of wind in her ears, and the Taoist nun subconsciously raised her hand to block. The next second, a powerful and heavy kick exploded directly on the side of her charming face.

    Bang!

    The wind is howling!

    That charming and pretty face instantly distorted, and her plump body smashed directly into the wall.

    Bricks and stones shattered, and blood splattered everywhere.

    Half of the face of the Taoist nun on the wall was bloody and bloody, and there was pain all over her body as if it was falling apart.

    Her mind was buzzing and her mouth was filled with the smell of blood. Just when she was about to speak, she spat out a mouthful of blood foam mixed with a few broken teeth.

    How is that possible?

    Her Yin Evil Talisman had clearly been struck, but it was shattered directly under the crystal thorn.

    It was something she condensed with the Yin Qi of the Corpse Demon. Not to mention the first level, even Xuan level warriors might not be able to block it.

    But the other party——

    Before she could finish her thoughts, a big hand suddenly grabbed her head, pulled her off the wall, and then slammed her to the ground.
title_en: Chapter 20 Die with one kick? This trash doesn't count either
